symbol_conversion.Definition

Creates a definition of information about the data that will be passed to the Search/Lookup API of the Refinitiv Data Platform.

Available as lseg.data.content.symbol_conversion.Definition.

Syntax

Definition(
    symbols: StrStrings,
    from_symbol_type: str | SymbolTypes = '_AllUnique',
    to_symbol_types: SymbolTypesType = ...,
    preferred_country_code: OptCountryCode = None,
    asset_class: OptAssetClass = None,
    asset_state: OptAssetState = None,
    extended_params: ExtendedParams = None,
)

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
symbols StrStrings Yes Single instrument or list of instruments to convert.
from_symbol_type str | SymbolTypes No '_AllUnique' Instrument code to convert from. Possible values: 'CUSIP', 'ISIN', 'SEDOL', 'RIC', 'ticker', 'lipperID', 'IMO' Default: '_AllUnique'
to_symbol_types SymbolTypesType No ... Instrument code to convert to. Possible values: 'CUSIP', 'ISIN', 'SEDOL', 'RIC', 'ticker', 'lipperID', 'IMO', 'OAPermID' Default: all symbol types are requested
preferred_country_code OptCountryCode No None Unique ISO 3166 code for country
asset_class OptAssetClass No None AssetClass value to build filter parameter.
asset_state OptAssetState No None AssetState value to build filter parameter.
extended_params ExtendedParams No None Specifies the parameters that will be merged with the request.

Methods

get_data

Sends a request to the Data Platform to retrieve the predefined data.

get_data(session: Session | None = None) -> T

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
session Session | None No None Session object. If it's not passed the default session will be used.

Returns

Response

Returns as the result of successful response from Data Platform.

get_data_async

Sends an asynchronous request to the Data Platform to retrieve the predefined data.

async get_data_async(
    session: Session | None = None,
    on_response: Callable | None = None,
    closure: str | None = None,
) -> T

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
session Session | None No None Session object. If it's not passed the default session will be used.
on_response Callable | None No None Callable function to process the retrieved data.
closure str | None No None Closure parameters that will be returned with the response.

Returns

Response

Returns as the result of successful response from Data Platform.

Properties

Property Description
asset_class Asset class used to build the request filter.
asset_state Asset state used to build the request filter.
extended_params Additional parameters merged with the request.
from_symbol_type Symbol type to convert from, used as the lookup scope.
preferred_country_code Boost expression built from the preferred country code.
symbols Instruments to convert, as a comma-separated string.
to_symbol_types Comma-separated fields selected in the request, including the symbol types to convert to.

Example

from lseg.data.content import symbol_conversion
definition = symbol_conversion.Definition(
    symbols=["US5949181045", "US02079K1079"],
    from_symbol_type=symbol_conversion.SymbolTypes.ISIN,
    to_symbol_types=[
        symbol_conversion.SymbolTypes.RIC,
        symbol_conversion.SymbolTypes.OA_PERM_ID
    ],
    preferred_country_code=symbol_conversion.CountryCode.USA,
    asset_class=[
       symbol_conversion.AssetClass.COMMODITIES,
       symbol_conversion.AssetClass.EQUITIES,
       symbol_conversion.AssetClass.WARRANTS
    ],
    asset_state=symbol_conversion.AssetState.INACTIVE
)
response = definition.get_data()
